components.note: 土 (earth) — 土 is earth and land, as in 地, 城, 块; 境 is a stretch of land, a border or condition.
竟 (jìng) — same sound — 境 is jìng, like 竟; 竟 also sounds out 镜 jìng.
刂 (knife) — 刂 is 刀 (knife) on the right, as in 到, 别, 利; 刺 is to stab.
朿 (cì) — 朿 is a thorn and gives the sound — 刺 is cì, same syllable.
亻 (person) — person radical; 佳 describes a fine person, then anything good, as in 最佳.
圭 (guī) — loose hint — 佳 is jiā; 圭 also sounds out 挂 guà and 鞋 xié.
广 (building) — 广 is a building or roof, as in 店, 床, 库; 废 is a ruined building, then discarded.
发 (fā) — loose hint — 废 is fèi, close in sound to 发 fā.
攵 (tap, strike) — 攵 marks an action, as in 教, 放, 收; 效 is to imitate or produce results.
交 (jiāo) — near sound — 效 is xiào; 交 also sounds out 校 xiào and 较 jiào.
口 (mouth) — a picture of an open mouth; as a radical it appears in characters of speech, eating and sounds — 吃, 喝, 叫, 吗.
今 (jīn) — the top part hints the sound — 金 is jīn, like 今; 金 means gold and metal.
金 (metal) — as a radical it shrinks to 钅 in simplified characters — 钱 money, 铁 iron, 钟 clock, 银 silver.
手 (hand) — 手 as in 拿, 打, 拳; 掌 is the palm of the hand, then to control.
尚 (shàng) — near sound — 掌 is zhǎng; 尚 also sounds out 常 cháng, 堂 táng and 赏 shǎng.
扌 (hand) — hand radical — 握 is to grasp, as in 握手 handshake.
屋 (wū) — near sound — 握 is wò; 屋 also sounds out 幄 wò.
来 (come, wheat) — traditional 麥 combined 來 (the old word for the wheat plant) with a foot 夂 — a grain brought in; 麦 is the wheat radical.
童 (child) — as a sound unit, 童 also appears in 瞳 tóng and 撞 zhuàng; the character itself means child, as in 儿童.
弓 (bow) — 弓 as in 张, 弯, 弹 — characters of stretching and drawing; 强 is about strength like a strong bow.
讠 (speech) — 讠 is the simplified 言, as in 说, 话, 请; 诺 is a spoken promise.
若 (ruò) — near sound — 诺 is nuò; 若 also sounds out 惹 rě.
月 (flesh) — ⺼ is the flesh radical (月 in 脸, 脑, 肚); 脖 is the neck.
孛 (bèi) — near sound — 脖 is bó; 勃 bó also shares it.
讠 (speech) — 讠 is the simplified 言, as in 说, 话, 语; 谍 is a spy's report, as in 间谍.
枼 (yè) — near sound — 谍 is dié; 枼 also sounds out 蝶 dié and 碟 dié.
具 (tool) — two hands 廾 (the bottom 八) hold something valuable above — to provide, and a tool, as in 工具; 具 also sounds out 惧 jù.
亻 (person) — person radical — 传 is something passed from person to person.
专 (zhuān) — near sound — 传 is chuán; 专 also sounds out 转 zhuǎn and 砖 zhuān.
氵 (water) — 氵 is water, as in 海, 河, 湖; 漫 is water overflowing, then spreading freely.
曼 (màn) — same sound — 漫 is màn; 曼 also sounds out 慢 màn.
巴 (bā) — 巴 gives the sound bā in 爸 bà, 吧 ba, 把 bǎ and 疤 bā, so it is a useful sound clue.
口 (mouth) — 口 is the mouth, as in 吃, 喝, 叫; 和 is harmony and speaking together.
禾 (hé) — same sound — 和 is hé, like 禾.
欠 (open mouth) — 欠 shows a person with an open mouth, as in 吹, 歌; 欣 is joy showing.
斤 (jīn) — near sound — 欣 is xīn; 斤 also sounds out 新 xīn.
贝 (shell, money) — 贝 is money or a gift, as in 财, 贵, 买; 赏 is a reward.
尚 (shàng) — same sound, different tone — 赏 is shǎng; 尚 also sounds out 掌 zhǎng and 常 cháng.
尢 (lame leg) — 尢 is a bent, limping leg, as in 尤, 就; 尴 describes an unsteady, awkward position.
监 (jiān) — near sound — 尴 is gān; 监 also sounds out 篮 lán.
尢 (lame leg) — 尢 is a limping leg, as in 尤, 就; 尬 is awkwardness, and appears almost only in 尴尬.
介 (jiè) — loose hint — 尬 is gà; 介 also sounds out 界 jiè.
纟 (silk, thread) — 纟 is the simplified 糸 (thread), as in 红, 给; 纪 first meant the thread end, then keeping record, as in 世纪.
己 (jǐ) — same sound, different tone — 纪 is jì; 己 also sounds out 记 jì.
兰 (orchid) — simplified from 蘭, which had the grass radical 艹 on top and 闌 giving the sound lán — a plant name.
鼠 (rat) — a picture of a rat with its teeth (臼 on top) and a tail; as a radical it is in rodent names.
木 (wood) — 木 is wood and trees, as in 树, 板, 桌; buildings with floors were built of wood, hence 楼.
娄 (lóu) — same sound — 楼 is lóu; 娄 also sounds out 搂 lǒu.
禾 (grain) — 禾 is grain, as in 种, 秋; 移 first meant grain swaying, then shifting and moving.
多 (duō) — the original sound clue — today 移 yí is only loosely related to 多 duō.
女 (woman) — 女 marks women and female roles, as in 妈, 姐, 妹.
支 (zhī) — near sound — 妓 is jì; 支 also sounds out 技 jì and 枝 zhī.
斤 (axe) — 斤 is an axe, as in 新, 析; 断 is to cut through, shown by the axe and threads cut.
灬 (fire) — 灬 is fire at the bottom, as in 热, 照, 点; 熟 is cooked food, then ripe and familiar.
孰 (shú) — same sound — 熟 is shú, like 孰.
心 (heart) — 心 marks thought, as in 想, 思, 念; 悉 is knowing completely, as in 熟悉.
釆 (distinguish) — 釆 is distinguishing details (also in 番, 采), so 悉 is to know something thoroughly.
夕 (evening) — 夕 is evening or dusk, as in 外, 多, 梦; 夜 is night.
亦 (yì) — near sound — 夜 is yè; 夜 also sounds out 液 yè.
犭 (animal) — 犭 is the animal radical (犬), as in 猫, 狗, 狼; 猜 once meant a suspicious, wary animal.
青 (qīng) — near sound — 猜 is cāi; 青 also sounds out 清, 请, 情 and 晴.
氵 (water) — 氵 is water — dyeing means soaking in a liquid.
木 (tree, plant) — 木 is the plant dye material, steeped in water to make colour.
扌 (hand) — hand radical — 抛 is to throw, as in 抛弃.
足 (foot) — 足 (⻊) marks feet and body positions, as in 跑, 跳, 路; 趴 is lying on the front.
八 (bā) — same sound — 趴 is pā; 八 is bā, like 扒 bā and 叭 bā.
扌 (hand) — hand radical — 按 is to press with the hand, as in 按摩 massage.
安 (ān) — same sound, different tone — 按 is àn; 安 also sounds out 案 àn.
女 (woman) — 女 marks women, as in 妈, 姐; 妙 first meant fine and delicate.
少 (shǎo) — loose hint — 妙 is miào; 少 also means few or little.
门 (gate, door) — 门 is a gate, as in 开, 关, 问, 间; 闭 puts a bar across it, so shut.
扌 (hand) — hand radical — 擅 is acting on one's own, then skilled at, as in 擅长.
亶 (dǎn) — near sound — 擅 is shàn; 亶 also sounds out 坛 tán and 胆 dǎn.
予 (give) — 幻 is 予 written reversed — giving turned around, an illusion.
艹 (grass, plants) — 艹 marks plants — medicine was made from herbs, as in 药 and 草.
约 (yuē) — near sound — 药 is yào; 约 also sounds out 钓 diào.
心 (heart) — 心 is the heart, as in 想, 思, 念; 忍 is a blade 刃 over the heart — enduring pain.
刃 (rèn) — near sound — 忍 is rěn; 刃 is a blade with an edge marked by a dot.
亻 (person) — person radical — 伴 is a companion, as in 伙伴.
半 (bàn) — same sound — 伴 is bàn, like 半; 半 also sounds out 拌 bàn and 叛 pàn.
